visual.general_description: Two H&E-stained skin sections at low (a) and higher (b) power showing a thickened epidermis and a dermal inflammatory infiltrate.
visual.detailed_description: Two microscopy panels are placed side by side with the letters printed at the top left of each. Panel a is a low-power view of full-thickness skin with a thickened undulating purple epidermis, a bluish cellular infiltrate in the upper dermis, pink collagen and glands in the mid dermis and fat lobules below. Panel b is a higher-power view of the epidermis and upper dermis with irregular epidermal thickening and clusters of small dark cells, some around vessels.

panels.general_description: Low-power H&E-stained skin section with thickened purple epidermis, a bluish cellular infiltrate in the upper dermis, glands and fat lobules in the deeper tissue.
panels.detailed_description: A full-thickness skin section is shown with the surface at the top. The epidermis is a purple band with a darker thickened layer and an irregular, undulating lower border. Beneath it the upper dermis contains bands and clusters of small dark blue-purple cells, and the pink collagenous dermis below contains scattered glandular and vascular structures. In the lower left a large lobule of pale clear fat cells and further pale fat lobules in the lower right are visible. There is no scale bar and no label other than the panel letter.
